macos.title: System Audio Permission Required
macos.description: Niuma needs permission to capture your screen's audio. Clicking the button will open System Settings.
macos.manualTitle: If permission is not granted automatically:
macos.manualSteps:
1. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording.
2. Find Niuma in the list and enable it, if not found then click on + and add Niuma.
macos.note: A restart of Niuma may be required after granting permission.

windows.title: System Audio Access
windows.description: Niuma needs to access your system audio. The button below will open the Sound settings panel for troubleshooting.
windows.manualTitle: To ensure Niuma can capture audio:
windows.manualSteps:
1. In Sound settings, ensure the correct speakers are set as the default device.
2. Check your device properties and disable any 'Exclusive Mode' settings.
windows.note: Windows does not require a specific permission prompt for audio capture.

linux.title: System Audio Setup
linux.description: Niuma captures audio using PulseAudio. Please ensure it is configured correctly.
linux.manualSteps:
1. Make sure you are running a PulseAudio server.
2. Check your system's sound settings and ensure the correct output device is set as default.
linux.note: There is no automatic setup for Linux. Access depends on your system's audio configuration.

undetermined.title: System Audio Permission
undetermined.description: Niuma needs permission to capture system audio.
undetermined.manualSteps: Please check your system's privacy or sound settings to allow Niuma to capture audio.
